_doc: forward-only, on THREE axes. `killed` may never fall - that is the absolute teeth count. `score` may only fall when `viable` GREW (new operators asked new questions); at an unchanged vocabulary it may never fall. `fixture_kills` may only fall: a kill via an errored fixture is weaker evidence than a kill via an assertion, and a spike in it is the signature of a broken injection (which once produced a fabricated 100% here).
